Extend the ribs. Harden them. Fangs.

...Never once had such an attack entered my imagination.

Why should it enter? Why should my imagination be required to accommodate this chutiyapa?

A gun that exploded with its own wielder. A burning sword that burned its own hand also. Defeat the enemy—that was the only thought in this armor. Body maintenance could go fuck itself.

Terrifying thing.

Anyway, the last move had missed also.
Masamune was falling.

Intestines. He was throwing intestines.

Naturally these were not ordinary internal organs. Naturally! By what standard anything was still natural, I no longer knew. Ribs had become teeth and now the intestines were offering home delivery.

They had been turned to armor steel.

And with a tremendous grip, they had me bound!
